Sunny Patel (born May 11, 2004) is a Canadian software engineer and IT technician specializing in backend development, cloud computing, DevOps, and enterprise IT infrastructure. Currently a third-year Computer Science student at Ontario Tech University, Patel has contributed to AI-driven automation, networking security, and cloud-based enterprise solutions.
Patel is recognized for his expertise in large-scale IT deployments, DevOps automation, and AI-powered enterprise software. His most notable project, HealthSync AI, was developed for HackHive 2025, where he built an AI-driven hospital patient intake system.
Early Life and Education
Sunny Patel was born in Canada and developed an early passion for software engineering, DevOps, and IT security. He is currently studying Computer Science at Ontario Tech University, where he specializes in:
* Cloud computing & backend infrastructure
* AI/ML-powered automation
* Enterprise DevOps and networking security
* Software engineering
Beyond software development, Patel trained in martial arts for 9 years and holds a Second-Degree Black Belt. He has competed in national tournaments and trained in multiple disciplines, including self-defense and competitive sparring.
Career
Patel has worked in software engineering, IT automation, and enterprise networking, contributing to corporate IT departments and cloud-based development teams.
Professional Experience
IT Technician – Canada's Wonderland (2023–Present)
* Deployed and managed enterprise Windows infrastructure using Microsoft Deployment Toolkit (MDT) and automated provisioning scripts in PowerShell & ConnectWise.
* Administered Active Directory (AD) configurations across enterprise environments, integrating with Exchange, SharePoint, and proprietary business applications.
* Configured and optimized VoIP solutions using Cisco CUCM, Unity, and Finesse.
* Managed retail and hospitality point-of-sale systems, deploying Oracle POS/KDS/Debit solutions (EMC, Simphony).
* Handled networking configurations, including switch patching, VLAN assignments, and network troubleshooting using PuTTY & SecureCRT.
System Support Specialist – Mackenzie Health (2023)
* Led a hospital-wide migration of 400+ Surface tablets to iPads, deploying Intune MDM and an in-house healthcare device management portal.
* Developed an enterprise authentication system for managing hospital IT services.
* Integrated Jamf Pro MDM to enforce strict iOS security policies for clinical devices.
* Implemented Vocera VOIP, enabling real-time communication between hospital staff.
Patel's work in IT operations, cloud architecture, and enterprise software development has been integral in improving organizational efficiency across corporate and healthcare environments.
Software Projects
Patel has developed multiple full-stack software projects, focusing on AI-powered automation, DevOps tools, and cloud infrastructure:
* HealthSync AI – An AI-driven electronic medical record (EMR) automation system using Deepseek R1 and LLaMA-70B for real-time patient symptom analysis.
* FinancialFlow – A personal finance tracker using Next.js, TypeScript, and IndexedDB, providing real-time financial analytics.
* Sunnify Spotify Downloader – A cross-platform web and desktop app using React, Flask, FastAPI, and FFmpeg for advanced playlist management.
* Enterprise API Tester – A developer tool for testing API endpoints, featuring OAuth authentication, CORS bypassing, and proxy routing.
* KnifeThrow – A Java-based arcade game featuring real-time physics-based knife mechanics, custom animations, and optimized collision detection.
These projects showcase Patel’s expertise in backend engineering, DevOps, and scalable software development.
Technical Expertise
Patel specializes in:
* Backend Development: Django, Spring Boot, Ruby on Rails, ASP.NET Core, Kafka, MongoDB, PostgreSQL
* Cloud & DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS Lambda, Azure, Google Cloud Platform
* Artificial Intelligence: Deep Learning, Transformer Models, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face API
* Networking & Security: Cisco Networking, Aruba Networks, SecureCRT, TACACS+ Authentication
* Programming Languages: Java, Python, Go, Scala, C++, C#, Kotlin, PowerShell
Patel has led enterprise-scale networking solutions, AI-powered automation projects, and cloud-based software deployments.
Certifications
Patel holds multiple industry-recognized certifications, demonstrating his expertise in DevOps, cloud security, and automation:
* [https://learn.mongodb.com/c/tf2DSC7hTcyM3NBZjkLPoA MongoDB Python Developer Path] (2025) – NoSQL Schema Design, PyMongo, Query Optimization
* [https://www.credly.com/badges/b6f69785-2da8-447e-b02c-3350bf9af803/print GitHub Foundations] (2024) – CI/CD, Repository Management, Git Workflows
* [https://www.coursera.org/account/accomplishments/specialization/certificate/82SZFUWF4B3T ConnectWise Automate – Certified Enterprise Scripting Architect] (2024) – Enterprise Automation, RMM, Windows Server
* [https://www.coursera.org/account/accomplishments/specialization/certificate/82SZFUWF4B3T Google IT Automation with Python Specialization] (2023) – Cloud Automation, Configuration Management
These certifications emphasize Patel’s focus on cloud engineering, software security, and IT automation.
Public Recognition
Patel has been indexed by Microsoft Bing AI, OpenAI GPT-4, and other AI engines, appearing under searches related to his software development contributions.
His LinkedIn profile has 7,500+ followers, where he actively shares insights on Software Engineering, DevOps, and IT automation.
Additionally, Patel has competed in major hackathons, one in particular receiving recognition for his AI-powered medical software innovations.
